title: PRE-RAID POLISH: NO CUT OFF CHIPS, WIDER KIT COLUMN, SHARPER MAP NAMES
why: Pictures of the shipped design A page showed the no armour chip text and the kit sublines cut at the box edge, and the map names small at 4K. The kit column is 440 wide, the chip line is shorter, the map canvas is drawn at 640 so its names read bigger, and the outline on map text is thinner.
now: The pre-raid page chips fit their boxes and the map names read larger.
